incident-bot: ALERT P1: spike of model init failures + node flaps in eu-central-1 GPU pool. 12 model-init OOMs, 2 container segfaults, artifact deserialization errors. Service error rate up ~6% across text-gen endpoints.

mike (oncall): I'm on. pulling logs and checking dashboards. which model(s) and which nodes? any customer-facing 5xxs?

nora (cs): two customers flagged: partner-zen (chat) and partner-halo (search). CS saw 5xx and elevated latency, sending initial note that we're investigating.

devon (runtime): errors observed: 
- OOM during KV cache allocation at model load (alloc request ~4.8GB)
- deserializer: short read / checksum mismatch on artifact shard
- nvrtc compile stalls leading to long-tail warmup times; some processes eventually segfault (exit 139)
Logs excerpt:
```
[2026-03-15T20:03:08Z] model_loader.go:271 ERROR model=floret-13b host=gpu-08 OOM allocating 4.8GB for kv_cache
[2026-03-15T20:03:09Z] deser.go:60 ERROR model=floret-13b deserializer: checksum mismatch (expected 0x7fa2, got 0x0000) on shard checkpoint.001
[2026-03-15T20:03:15Z] compile.cc:210 WARN nvrtc compile stuck >45s for kernel attention_fused
[2026-03-15T20:03:21Z] procmon.go:133 ERROR container exited with signal 11 (segfault) pid=24877
```

devon (runtime): initial triage: appears to be a partial artifact write on a subset of nodes (some nodes have truncated shards), combined with a simultaneous canary warmup rollout that hit many nodes concurrently. The JIT compile backlog + retries pushes memory and CPU, causing OOM and occasional segfaults.

alex (infra): checking node metrics: gpu-08 shows high write latencies and occasional filesystem I/O errors; `smartctl` shows no disk failure but udev logs show repeated scrub/timeout. Network overlay has small packet loss on that rack.

ops-bot: runbook recommends: 1) pause current model rollouts 2) set pool init concurrency to 1 3) add artifact integrity hold 4) cordon affected nodes and replace 5) route traffic to fallback model or standby region.

mike (oncall): executing mitigations now:
- Pause rollout: `POST /internal/rollouts/pause {"model":"floret-13b"}` -> 200
- Set pool var: `infractl set pool eu-central-1 init_concurrency=1`
- Add runtime env: `REDWOOD_INIT_RETRY_LIMIT=1` and `REDWOOD_INIT_BACKOFF_MS=1500` to reduce retry storms

mike (oncall): routing change in progress: adding traffic split to fallback `floret-13b-quant` with gradual 20% shift.

pete (oncall-next): I'll take handoff after Mike. pls tag me for final status.

devon (runtime): pulled artifact shards from node-08: checkpoint.001 is 0 bytes in places; S3 copy shows correct size. Suggest rehydrate from S3 artifacts and validate checksums before marking node healthy. Command to rehydrate:
```
ssh root@gpu-08 'systemctl stop redwood-runtime && rm -rf /var/models/floret-13b/* && aws s3 cp s3://model-artifacts/floret-13b/v2/ /var/models/floret-13b/ --recursive && sha256sum -c /var/models/floret-13b/checksums.txt'
```

alex (infra): cordoned gpu-08 and started replacement. also isolating rack to avoid noisy neighbor writes. scheduling block-level checksum scan across pool.

nora (cs): customers updated: short note sent, telling them we mitigated traffic and are restoring capacity; ETA 60-90m. one customer asked about data loss — none, this is artifact storage issue.

devon (runtime): additional mitigation: disabling in-place JIT compilation on affected pool to avoid NVRTC stalls: `REDWOOD_DISABLE_JIT=true` applied to runtime config and pods rolling restarted. also lowered NVRTC_TIMEOUT_MS to 15000 so hung compilations fail fast.

ops-bot: FYI disabling JIT may raise CPU usage on host-side and slightly increase token latency; monitored.

mike (oncall): rehydration of artifacts started on a fenced node; checksum verifies on two nodes. reactivated warmups only on verified nodes with `--max-concurrency=1` flag.

devon (runtime): repro test: loading floret-13b on verified node completes in 23s, KV alloc ok. no segfault. nodes that had truncated artifacts show repeated deser errors when tried.

mike (oncall): node replacements in progress; we will not reattach old nodes until full fs/blk validation.

nora (cs): partner-zen confirms degraded -> partial function recovered after redirect to fallback model. partner-halo still seeing intermittent 503s; devon, can you run a per-tenant trace?

devon (runtime): running per-tenant traces for partner-halo now; logs show few requests routed to nodes still in warmup - I'll patch routing to avoid them.

mike (oncall): handoff plan: I'll hand to @pete in 20m. current status summary for handoff:
- probable root cause: partial artifact writes/corrupted shards on subset of nodes + simultaneous warmup rollout -> retry/compile storms -> OOMs and segfaults.
- mitigations applied: paused rollout, set init_concurrency=1, limited init retries/backoff, disabled JIT on pool, rehydrated artifacts from S3 with checksum verification, cordoned and replacing affected nodes, traffic split to fallback quantized model.
- customer impact: ~5k requests affected, two partners impacted; partial recovery via fallback routing.
- follow-ups: audit artifact upload pipeline (ensure atomic writes and checksum writes), add node-level pre-check before marking artifacts present, consider warmup stagger policy and enforce progressive rollout with artifact validation.

pete (oncall-next): ack taking over. please add me to incident doc and open postmortem ticket. assign to devon for RCA.

ops-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: status=mitigating->watching, escalation=safe, incident_owner=mike, last_update=3460001800

alex (infra): block-level checksum sweep completed on pool; found 4 nodes with partial artifact shards — all are being reimaged. investigating why artifact copy was non-atomic (S3 sync vs put in our uploader).

devon (runtime): no new OOMs or segfaults in last 12m. tail latency returning to baseline.

nora (cs): sending another customer update noting recovered service for most flows, we will follow-up postmortem with timeline and action items within 24h.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: final_status=closed, duration=00:32:46, root_cause_summary="incomplete artifact writes (partial shards) combined with concurrent warmup rollout causing retry and compile pressure -> OOMs and segfaults. mitigations: paused rollout, throttled init concurrency, rehydrated artifacts with checksum verification, cordoned/replaced nodes, disabled JIT on pool temporarily"
